== Source chronology and field audit ==
Five documented image layouts are retained below. Copy timestamps establish preserved full faces; the archive capture and printed month edition establish the partial-source occurrences. They do not establish unknown original publication days.
* '''Original full face''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V)]]): preserved in [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 the first Holotable repository import, 8 July 2018]. The card may predate that import. No errata mark.
* '''Errata 1, earlier partial''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata)]]): the archived official source contains a cutout with the original text and an omitted artwork window. No errata mark.<ref>[[:File:Virtual-Set-8-archive-2021-10-05-pages-1-7-extract.pdf|Official Set 8 source archived 5 October 2021]], original page 7 (lossless extract page 2). The capture dates the preserved copy; the partial’s first publication day is unknown.</ref>
* '''Errata 2, July 2022 full face''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 2)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/44c7bc5c258703260424a3793cd55f0221d672e4/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/endorewokvillage.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-07-10T17:26:49Z. The later [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/6489b69cc5f1545e5e24ac7b2d68ae446cf03769 GIF copy] was committed 19:39:59Z the same UTC day. Their visible image is the same; the game-text words retain the original wording. No errata mark.
* '''Errata 3, current full face''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 3)]]): the [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual8-Light/hires/endorewokvillage.png source PNG] was authored and committed 2022-12-12T00:40:28Z; the pixel-identical [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c GIF copy] was committed 08:04:04Z that day. It changes both side-specific text bars and prints E1. The source-only comparison below preserves the actual words and icon groups.
* '''Errata 4, current published partial''' ([[Endor: Ewok Village (V) (Errata 4)]]): December 2022 sheet edition; the cutout omits the artwork window and prints E1. It retains the supported <code>208_23</code> mapping. The same partial occurs in the June 2023 Set 8 sheet: the two official PDFs contain byte-identical embedded JPEGs and identical mask streams, so this repeat is one image state.<ref>[[:File:PC-Errata-December-2022.pdf|Official Errata Sheet, December 2022]], page 5. The cover and footer print the month edition; the exact publication day is unknown. The source filename’s 19 December date comes from PDF build metadata and is not established as a publication date. [[:File:Virtual-Set-8-June-2023.pdf|Official Set 8 sheet, June 2023 edition]], page 7, image xref122 and mask121.</ref>
The image ordinals and actual printed marks are recorded in [[Players Committee transcription errors]]. [[File:V8-L-endorewokvillage-five-published-layouts.png|thumb|center|300px|Five preserved published layouts, shown without changing their source pixels.]] [[File:V8-L-endorewokvillage-July-December-2022-source-text-comparison.png|thumb|center|300px|The two full-face text bars before and after the December 2022 change.]]

The new archived cutout preserves the printed title, uniqueness dots, both game-text bars and complete icon groups. Rarity is inherited host metadata; location destiny 0 is rule-derived (Advanced Rulebook (2023), pages 30/83), not printed. Character-only fields, persona and lore do not apply. No new executable ID is assigned. The existing 208_23 mapping remains on the moved current partial. Exact source hashes, rendered source regions, image comparisons and per-field statuses are retained in story 309 evidence. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]],13 November 2026 (UTC).
